title: Recap: Foundation models for language are omnipresent
reading: A recap slide making the point that language foundation models are now everywhere in everyday tools. It carries no body text, relying instead on a screenshot of a chatbot prompt interface and a cluster of vendor logos to illustrate ubiquity.

visuals.description: ChatGPT-style chat entry screen reading 'How can I help, Cheng?' with an 'Ask anything' input box and buttons for Search, Deep research, Create image, plus voice icons.
visuals.assertion: Consumer-facing LLM interfaces are a routine, general-purpose entry point offering search, research and image generation.

visuals.description: Logos of ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Claude.
visuals.assertion: Multiple major vendors offer widely used language foundation model products.

concepts.name: Foundation models for language
concepts.why_it_matters: Large pretrained language models underlie the widely deployed assistants shown.

verbatim_spans: Recap: Foundation models for language are omnipresent
